idea: Three printing inks (black, vermilion, ochre) on unbleached paper, plus four papercut colours used only as flat layers for tribes and statuses.

colours.name: Unbleached paper
colours.use: Page background, card panels, text on dark inks

colours.name: Kraft
colours.use: Second paper layer: panels, trays, Neutral tribe band

colours.name: Lamp-black ink
colours.use: All lines and body text; the Attack shield; Hunters tribe

colours.name: Plate paper
colours.use: Board tray (round 2): unbleached paper cut to the 4–3 brick, black only for linework

colours.name: Vermilion ink
colours.use: Health heart, damage, primary buttons, the next-opponent mark, keywords, Great beasts tribe

colours.name: Ochre ink
colours.use: Gold, tier stars, golden units, Hive tribe (always with black text)

colours.name: Meadow green
colours.use: Papercut layer: Hedgerow folk tribe, positive results (won)

colours.name: Cobalt
colours.use: Papercut layer: Birds tribe, freeze button and frozen stamp

colours.name: Belladonna plum
colours.use: Nightshade status and the halving seal, Fairies tribe

colours.name: Frost
colours.use: Frozen overprint tint on shop offers (black or cobalt text on it)

colours.name: Rose
colours.use: Small papercut accents in ornament only; never carries meaning

colours.name: Ash
colours.use: Eliminated players, disabled controls, empty-slot labels (5.8:1 on paper, 4.6:1 on kraft)

contrast_checked._rule: Every text pairing above passes WCAG AA for body text (4.5:1). Ochre never carries paper-coloured text. Ash is used for disabled or eliminated text and checked separately.
